summary: Executable ABI-2 project, package, process, tooling, C++17, Python, CLI and LSP subsets with bounded inputs, host-owned allocation, explicit lifetimes and installed relocation coverage.

facilities.subset: Bounded immutable parsing and idempotent formatting of declarative On1xfile 1 kind/name/directory/target/dependency records; unsupported directives reject without executing templates or policy.
Deep-copied deterministic dependency-before-consumer graphs, canonical SHA-256 identity, cycle/missing/conflict diagnostics and provenance records.
Deterministic resolution over host-supplied local/cache candidates and exact lock entries; no path opening, executable loading or network fallback.
Bounded absolute-path argv and replacement-environment requests behind authorize/execute/finish host callbacks; no shell or executable-name resolution.
Revision-bound unverified edit candidates, namespaced command validation, manifest formatting and authorized adapters to canonical compiler formatting/catalogue checks.
blockers: No stable compiler session or semantic index is available at this baseline.
Completion, hover, symbols, references, rename, refactoring, REPL, debug, coverage and profiling APIs remain unsupported.

facilities.subset: Installable deterministic data-only info, inspection and bounded validation CLI for supported manifests, locks, catalogues, contracts and extension-manifest envelopes.
C++17 move-only RAII owners and executable CPython ctypes access to the implemented project subset.
blockers: Python allocation currently requires POSIX posix_memalign.
D, Rust, Lua/Mune, Crystal, Zig and OCaml bindings are not shipped without executable build and lifecycle coverage.

facilities.subset: Bounded compiler-reported validated repairs become versioned LSP edits; unverified candidates are disabled suggestions and stale actions are cleared.

blockers: Canonical checked-HIR symbol, scope and revision-aware query views are not public.

unsupported_paths: The reusable manifest API does not execute On1xfile templates, profiles, commands, build policy, PPX or extension code.
The package API does not fetch from a network, discover candidates from paths or trust lockfile-supplied executable locations.
The process API does not invoke a shell, search PATH or execute without a nonzero host authorization token.
Code-action candidates are not proof of correctness and are never published without authoritative compiler validation.
LSP candidate repairs remain disabled; only compiler-reported validated repairs are exposed as edits.
No WASM, sandbox or process-isolation claim is made by this project layer.

cross_owner_api_requests.required_api: Shared ABI-2 prefix, allocator, string/bytes/span, diagnostic sink, cancellation and extended status types from On1xSDK-ABI.h, On1xSDK-Allocator.h, On1xSDK-String.h, On1xSDK-Span.h, On1xSDK-Diagnostic.h, On1xSDK-Cancellation.h and On1xSDK-Status.h.
cross_owner_api_requests.reason: The baseline has only ABI-v1 core declarations, so the project service must currently use a project-prefixed ABI-2-compatible subset. Shared definitions are required before all SDK-2 subsystems can exchange owned buffers and cancellation/status values without duplicate protocols.
cross_owner_api_requests.proposed_signature: typedef struct On1xSDK_ABIHeader { uint32_t abi_version; uint32_t struct_size; } On1xSDK_ABIHeader; typedef struct On1xSDK_Allocator { On1xSDK_ABIHeader abi; void *context; On1xSDK_AllocateFn allocate; On1xSDK_ReallocateFn reallocate; On1xSDK_ReleaseFn release; } On1xSDK_Allocator;

cross_owner_api_requests.required_api: Revision-aware in-process compiler formatting, diagnostics and repair-validation sessions over host VFS/source handles.
cross_owner_api_requests.reason: Current formatter and diagnostic-catalog operations truthfully use an explicitly authorized on1xc argv request because no reusable compiler session exists. An in-process service would remove process overhead without creating a second parser or semantic authority.
cross_owner_api_requests.proposed_signature: On1xSDK_Status on1x_sdk_compiler_format(On1xSDK_CompilerSession *, On1xSDK_SourceHandle, const On1xSDK_FormatOptions *, On1xSDK_Buffer **); On1xSDK_Status on1x_sdk_compiler_validate_repairs(On1xSDK_CompilerSession *, On1xSDK_SourceRevision, const On1xSDK_RepairCandidate *, size_t, On1xSDK_RepairSet **);

cross_owner_api_requests.required_api: Immutable checked-HIR symbol/scope/reference snapshots keyed by source revision.
cross_owner_api_requests.reason: A truthful semantic index, hover, references and rename implementation cannot be built from point diagnostics or reparsed source.
